name: Police Emergency Response
description: Immediate dispatch of police mobile squad for physical threats, violence in progress, robbery, or home invasion anywhere in Pakistan.

name: Rescue 1122 Emergency Medical & Fire Service
description: Paramedic ambulance, fire rescue, and disaster emergency response across Punjab, KP, and key cities.

name: National Human Rights & Legal Helpline (Ministry of Human Rights)
description: Government of Pakistan toll-free helpline providing legal advice, emergency shelter coordination, and relief for human rights violations and domestic abuse.

name: Rozan Women & Youth Counseling Helpline
description: Confidential psychosocial counseling, crisis intervention, and legal referrals for survivors of emotional, physical, and domestic abuse.

name: Edhi Foundation Emergency & Ambulance
description: Nationwide emergency ambulance, orphanages, women shelter homes (Edhi Home / Apna Ghar), and relief services.

name: Digital Rights Foundation (DRF) Cyber Harassment Helpline
description: Dedicated confidential helpline for women and marginalized individuals facing online blackmail, non-consensual image sharing, and cyberstalking.

name: FIA Cyber Crime Reporting & Helpline
description: Official federal law enforcement helpline for registering formal complaints against cyber crimes, identity theft, and online extortion.

name: Punjab Police Women Safety App & Helpline
description: Dedicated Punjab Police helpline and mobile alert system for female travelers, workplace harassment, or street stalking.
